import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter
def f(t):
    t=np.array(t); H,W=t.shape
    sep_rows={i for i in range(H) if len(set(t[i]))==1}
    sep_cols={j for j in range(W) if len(set(t[:,j]))==1}
    cnt=Counter()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if i not in sep_rows and j not in sep_cols: cnt[t[i,j]]+=1
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mks=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg]
    rows=[-1]+[i for i in range(H) if i in sep_rows]+[H]
    cols=[-1]+[j for j in range(W) if j in sep_cols]+[W]
    best=None
    for a,b in zip(rows[:-1],rows[1:]):
        for c,d in zip(cols[:-1],cols[1:]):
            for mk in mks:
                n=int((t[a+1:b,c+1:d]==mk).sum())
                if best is None or n>best[0]: best=(n,mk,a,b,c,d)
    _,mk,a,b,c,d=best
    o=t.copy()
    o[a+1:b,c+1:d]=mk
    mask=np.zeros_like(o,bool); mask[(np.arange(H)[:,None]>=a+1)&(np.arange(H)[:,None]<b)&(np.arange(W)[None,:]>=c+1)&(np.arange(W)[None,:]<d)]=True
    rs=np.isin(np.arange(H)[:,None],list(sep_rows))[None,:]
    cs=np.isin(np.arange(W)[None,:],list(sep_cols))[:,None]
    clear=(rs|cs).any(axis=1)&(~mask&~(rs|cs)).T  # outside region but not separator
    vals=np.where(clear,[mks[0]],o)
    return [row.tolist() for row in np.where(vals,vals,None)]

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter
def f(t):
    t=np.array(t); H,W=t.shape
    sep_rows={i for i in range(H) if len(set(t[i]))==1}
    sep_cols={j for j in range(W) if len(set(t[:,j]))==1}
    cnt=Counter()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if i not in sep_rows and j not in sep_cols: cnt[t[i,j]]+=1
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mks=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg]
    rows=[-1]+[i for i in range(H) if i in sep_rows]+[H]
    cols=[-1]+[j for j in range(W) if j in sep_cols]+[W]
    best=None
    for a,b in zip(rows[:-1],rows[1:]):
        for c,d in zip(cols[:-1],cols[1:]):
            for mk in mks:
                n=int((t[a+1:b,c+1:d]==mk).sum())
                if best is None or n>best[0]: best=(n,mk,a,b,c,d)
    _,mk,a,b,c,d=best
    o=t.copy()
    o[a+1:b,c+1:d]=mk
    mask=np.zeros_like(o,bool); mask[(np.arange(H)[:,None]>=a+1)&(np.arange(H)[:,None]<b)&(np.arange(W)[None,:]>=c+1)&(np.arange(W)[None,:]<d)]=True
    rs=np.isin(np.arange(H)[:,None],list(sep_rows))[None,:]
    cs=np.isin(np.arange(W)[None,:],list(sep_cols))[:,None]
    keepmask=(rs|cs)|mask
    o=~keepmask & (o==mk)  # outside region AND not sep -> bg? no.
    outgrid=o.tolist()
    return outgrid

print(f(di)==do.tolist())

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def regions(t):
    t=np.array(t); H,W=t.shape
    sr={i for i in range(H) if len(set(t[i]))==1}; sc={j for j in range(W) if len(set(t[:,j]))==1}
    rbs=[0]+sorted(sr)+[H]; cbs=[0]+sorted(sc)+[W]
    res=[]
    for a,b in zip(rbs[:-1],rbs[1:]):
        for c,d in zip(cbs[:-1],cbs[1:]):
            sub=t[a:b,c:d]
            cc=Counter(sub.flatten().tolist())
            if not cc or len(cc)==1: continue
            bgv=max(cc,key=cc.get)
            mks=[v for v in cc if v!=bgv]
            mk=mks[0] if len(mks)==1 else min(mks)
            n=int((sub==mk).sum()); area=(b-a)*(d-c)
            L=-np.ones((b-a,d-c),int)
            sizes=[]; nn=0
            hgt,wdt=b-a,d-c
            q=list(zip(*np.where(sub==mk)))
            for sy,sx in q:
                if L[sy,sx]!=-1: continue
                st=[(sy,sx)];L[sy,sx]=nn;siz=1
                while st:
                    yy,xx=st.pop()
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
                        if 0<=ny<hgt and 0<=nx<wdt and sub[ny,nx]==mk and L[ny,nx]==-1:
                            L[ny,nx]=nn;siz+=1;st.append((ny,nx))
                sizes.append(siz);nn+=1
            mx=max(sizes) if sizes else 0

import os,glob,re,json
def loadf(p):
    t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    # find row separators (all same value v != background?) - use: rows that are uniform and separate bands
    def is_sep_row(r): return len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0] not in {7}  # placeholder
    # proper: rows entirely 0
    def zero_rows(): return [r for r in range(H) if all(x==0 for x in g[r])]
    def zero_cols(): return [c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==0 for r in range(H))]
    rowbands=[]; prev=0
    for r in zero_rows()+[H]:
        if r>prev: rowbands.append((prev,r-1)); prev=r+1
    colbands=[]; prev=0
    for c in zero_cols()+[W]:
        if c>prev: colbands.append((prev,c-1)); prev=c+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=set()
    for b0,b1 in rowbands:
        for c0,c1 in colbands:
            sub=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(b0,b1+1)]
            vals=set(x for row in sub for x in row)
            # non-background color = the one appearing but not dominant? assume exactly two colors incl 0
            nz=[x for row in sub for x in row if x!=0]
            from collections import Counter
            cnt=Counter(nz)
            bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
            other=[x for x in vals if x!=0 and x!=bg]
            if not other: continue
            val=other[0]
            # components of val in sub
            hh,ww=len(sub),len(sub[0])
            compst=set(); comps=[]
            for r in range(hh):
                for c in range(ww):
                    if sub[r][c]==val and (r,c) not in compst:
                        st=[(r,c)]; compst.add((r,c)); cc=[]
                        while st:
                            a,b=st.pop(); cc.append((a,b))
                            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                                x,y=a+dx,b+dy
                                if 0<=x<hh and 0<=y<ww and sub[x][y]==val and (x,y) not in compst:
                                    compst.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
                        comps.append(cc)
            for cc in comps:

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

import numpy as np, collections
G=load()
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=g.copy()
    rows,cols=g.shape
    rsep=[r for r in range(rows) if len(set(g[r].tolist()))==1]
    if not rsep: return out.tolist()
    sep=g[rsep[0]][0]
    rb=[];prev=0
    for r in rsep+[rows]:
        if r>prev: rb.append((prev,r)); prev=r+1
    csep=[c for c in range(cols) if all(g[r][c]==sep for r in range(rows))]
    cb=[];prev=0
    for c in csep+[cols]:
        if c>prev: cb.append((prev,c)); prev=c+1
    for (r0,r1) in rb:
        for (c0,c1) in cb:
            blk=g[r0:r1,c0:c1]
            vals,cnts=np.unique(blk,return_counts=True)
            nz=[(int(v),int(c)) for v,c in zip(vals,cnts) if v!=sep]
            if not nz or len(nz)<2: continue
            mn=min(c for _,c in nz); win=[v for v,c in nz if c==mn]
            if len(win)!=1: continue
            out[r0:r1,c0:c1]=win[0]
    return out.tolist()
